dedupe_keys.name: repere de nivellement du canevas geodesique de saint nazaire agglomeration la carene

description: Repère de nivellement du canevas géodésique de Saint-Nazaire Agglomération - la CARENE is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by CARENE. The topographical canvas covers the entire territory of the agglomeration of Saint-Nazaire. It is a set of geodetic points of support, materialized in the field, known in planimetric position (X, Y) and altimeter (Z) and serving as a framework for the realization of a topographic survey. Coverage: CARENE. The portal shows the English title as "Benchmark for the levelling of the geodetic canvas of Saint-Nazaire Agglomeration - la CARENE" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is CARENE. Its keywords include geodesie, urbanisme-logement, canevas, topographie, territoires, altimetrie. The listing shows 4 download or service links in JSON, ZIP, CSV. The listing shows 2026-08-13 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
